properties.description: ADLS Gen2 (stnfmfgdev). Auth = ADF system-assigned managed identity with 'Storage Blob Data Contributor'. No account keys.
Metadata/control DB. Auth = ADF managed identity (CREATE USER ... FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER).
All secrets (DB passwords, API client secret, alert webhook). ADF managed identity has 'Key Vault Secrets User'.
CMMS (maintenance) REST API. OAuth2 bearer token obtained per run by a Web activity (client secret in Key Vault) and passed as a header.
Self-hosted IR on 2 HA nodes in the plant data centre. Reaches on-prem SQL Server (MES) and Oracle (ERP) over the private network; outbound 443 only to Azure (no inbound firewall rules).
Starts the Databricks batch job (Jobs API 2.1, ADF managed identity added to the workspace as a service principal) and polls until it terminates. Alerts + fails if the job did not succeed.
On-prem Oracle ERP via self-hosted IR. Read-only user; password from Key Vault.
On-prem MES SQL Server via self-hosted IR. Read-only CDC login; password from Key Vault.
CMMS REST API: OAuth2 token -> updated_since/updated_until window (5-min safety lag) -> paginated Copy (page=1..n until data is empty) -> flatten $.data -> parquet. Count from meta.total_count.
